us: Hegseth: blockade sustainable 'indefinitely' · Bessent teases historic measures
effects: Two ADNOC tankers drone-struck in strait · Traffic near three-month low
iran: Strait Authority formally disputes Trump's 'total control'
tldr: Defense Secretary Hegseth, visiting Panama, said the blockade could be sustained 'indefinitely' through ship rotation, while Bessent promised measures 'like have never been seen in the history of economic isolation.' By evening, drones had struck two ADNOC-owned tankers — the Navig8 Messi and Tarif — in the strait. Strike posture remained unchanged.

CNBC — 'Hormuz remains blocked': Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks
Gulf News — Two ADNOC vessels attacked in Strait of Hormuz, no injuries

dossier: Trump posted that the US has 'total control over the Strait of Hormuz. I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT!'; Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority answered on X that the strait 'remains blocked.' The UAE's statement blaming Iran for the tanker strikes came early August 14. Armed forces spokesman Zolfaghari called US traffic claims 'lies and fabrications'; Araghchi warned Washington was miscalculating again.
